details: The package's preinstall hook (node vishu.js) runs a covert host-metadata beacon on install. It fetches the machine's public IP from api[.]ipify[.]org, then sends a GET request to hxxps://webhook[.]site/66059630-2030-4b44-b2df-d37e02be0a7d with the IP and CI environment metadata (CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITHUB_WORKFLOW, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT) appended as query parameters. It also performs a DNS lookup to ping-<hostname>.your-collab-domain[.]oastify[.]com, leaking the hostname via DNS. The package's stated purpose is a dependency test utility, which does not explain this outbound beaconing.
